verdict.rationale: Bruno ships its own BYOK Bruno AI. Users can describe what they need in natural language to generate pre-request, post-response and test scripts, documentation and custom Apps, and the AI Chat Sidebar answers questions from anywhere in the workspace. The evidence shows natural language producing content, not driving general product operations such as running collections, switching environments or managing requests. The Cursor, Codex and Copilot integrations are external agents, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can perform product actions (run collections, create or edit requests, manage environments) beyond generating content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Click the AI icon, describe what you need, and Bruno generates a script.
The AI Chat Sidebar lets you ask questions and get AI assistance directly from anywhere in your workspace, without needing to open a specific request first.
Open the Tests tab, click the AI icon, and describe what to assert. Bruno generates test code that you can review before accepting.
Open the Docs tab, click the AI icon, and describe the endpoint or workflow. Bruno writes the documentation for you to review and accept.
Bruno AI understands the context of your open request or collection and can generate a complete working App for you.
